rationale: No existing E2E spec exercises the invoice history table or its currency formatting. The closest match, Onboarding/billing.spec.js, covers the billing landing/trial strip only: it pins list_subscription to provider 'stripe' but never hits GET /billings/invoices and makes no assertion on invoice amounts. The dev's changed file is a Vitest unit spec (invoiceTable.spec.ts), not Playwright. This is a brand-new spec in the Management area per run-context, so it must be appended to the Management shard's run_files in ci_matrix.json.
